subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should maintainers require redacted live Vertex or Gemini CLI proof for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83991 before accepting the sanitizer slice, or explicitly override the proof gate?
rationale: The source-level sanitizer gap is clear, but the reported failure is credentialed external-provider behavior and the active PR itself states live provider proof is missing.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the sanitizer PR open until exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed route succeeds.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A Google provider owner can merge the narrow sanitizer change based on source-level proof while leaving this issue open for any remaining provider-auth follow-up.

options.title: Consolidate broader repair
options.body: Pause the sanitizer PR only if maintainers want one combined Google Vertex auth/setup/gaxios landing path.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the sanitizer PR open until exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed route succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the SDK-boundary Google thinking helper move that owns the remaining narrow guard and has adjacent Vertex history.
